positions.name: AsyncRememberContractMaxims
positions.frame: how is the async remember contract crystallized as ratified operational maxims in pipeline vocabulary?
positions.why: src-1 ratifies the contract's two halves (receipt in seconds, extraction watched by polling a cursor); src-2 states its guarantees as matched negations (no blocking call, no lost work); src-3 reframes the same contract as a key decision (dispatch, then poll or piggyback). All three perform the same settled contract as terse technical maxims carrying ratification authority — Wynn's original act and Xena's reframing cohere under one directional read of the contract's operational terms, with the tension of two speakers performing the ratification in different stances (direct declaration vs. authority-framed restatement).
